name: command-host-params
description: command.run of a host command checks its parameters against the params schema of the host declaration before the command runs (docs/spec/exposure.md#command-parameters): a missing member of required is refused with -32602 and the text of docs/spec/cases/command-params.json, and the command does not run. The registry of each host runs the other cases of that file.

error.message: command host.window.move: parameter y is required
